point: 用 Q 函数引导 batch online RL 比纯模仿学习类方法显著提升性能。
quote_en: we observe that the use of Q-functions to guide batch online RL significantly improves performance over imitation-based methods

point: 隐式策略抽取(在策略分布内选最优动作)优于离线RL传统的显式策略抽取。
quote_en: an implicit method of policy extraction—via choosing the best action in the distribution of the policy—is necessary over traditional explicit policy extraction methods from offline RL

point: 更具表达力的策略类优于表达力差的策略类。
quote_en: we show that an expressive policy class is preferred over less expressive policy classes

point: 在配方上加少量时间相关噪声(O-U过程)带来进一步性能提升。
quote_en: using temporally-correlated noise to obtain more diversity, results in further performance gains

point: 整套配方在六个机器人操作任务上相比此前方法最多带来2倍性能提升。
quote_en: our recipe results in up to 2× performance improvement over previous methods on a set of six complex robotic manipulation tasks from Robomimic [7], Adroit [8], and MimicGen [9]

point: 在真实机器人任务上,3轮batch online RL把初始策略的成功率提升了30%。
quote_en: we validate the practicality of the recipe on a challenging real-world robotics task, improving over the initial policy by 30% in success rate in three iterations of batch online RL

point: batch online RL设定:在初始数据集上训策略→部署时收集成批自主数据→在累积数据集上重训。
quote_en: in which a policy is trained on an initial dataset, used to collect batches of autonomous data during deployment, and then re-trained on the accumulated dataset

point: 本文主要采用Implicit Q-Learning(IQL):用expectile拟合值函数,再用它更新Q函数(式1、式2)。
quote_en: it aims to minimize the following objectives for learning a parameterized Q-function

point: τ是控制值函数多大程度逼近Q函数最大值的超参数,τ越大越接近最大值。
quote_en: is a hyperparameter that controls how much the value function approaches the maximum of the Q-function, with greater

point: 显式策略抽取用Advantage-Weighted Regression(AWR)作为代表方法,其超参β在行为克隆和逼近Q最大值之间插值。
quote_en: we consider Advantage-Weighted Regression (AWR) [16] as a canonical example of

point: value-based RL的默认策略抽取仅用Q函数引导:rollout时从策略采样多个动作选Q最大者。
quote_en: during rollouts, multiple actions {a_i}_{i=1,2,...,N} are sampled from the policy and the best action arg max_{a_i} Q(s, a_i) is selected

point: 用扩散策略作base policy时,该实例即Implicit Diffusion Q-Learning(IDQL)。
quote_en: this can be instantiated as Implicit Diffusion Q-Learning (IDQL)

point: 时间相关噪声用Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程建模,加到自主rollout的动作上。
quote_en: applying a small amount of temporally correlated noise modeled as an Ornstein–Uhlenbeck process during autonomous rollouts

point: 仿真用六个连续控制环境:Robomimic的Lift/Can/Square、MimicGen的Stack/Threading、Adroit的Pen。
quote_en: We choose six challenging continuous control environments in simulation: Lift, Can, and Square from Robomimic [7]; Stack and Threading from Mimicgen [9]; and Pen from Adroit [8]

point: 初始数据集D_0规模5到100条示范,选择使base policy π_0成功率落在30-65%。
quote_en: The size of D_0 varies from 5 to 100 demonstrations depending on the task difficulty; we choose this size such that the base policy π_0 performs at a success rate between 30–65%

point: 跑N=10到20轮batch online RL,每轮M=200条rollout。
quote_en: We run N=10 to 20 iterations of batch online RL with M=200 rollouts per iteration

point: value-based RL在六个任务上倾向于显著优于IL类方法;纯IL在所有任务上表现最差。
quote_en: we observe that value-based RL methods tend to significantly outperform IL-based methods. Vanilla IL performs the worst on all tasks

point: Filtered-IL虽有初期改善,但常快速收敛到次优,被value-based RL超过。
quote_en: Filtered-IL, while exhibiting an initial improvement, often converges quickly to suboptimal performance compared to value-based RL

point: value-based RL产生并消费比模仿类方法更多样的数据(state visitation热力图更分散)。
quote_en: value-based RL methods achieve more state diversity in successful rollouts

point: 数据规模扩大时value-based RL扩展性最好,除一个任务外随数据增多显著更优;IL/filtered-IL随数据增多趋于饱和。
quote_en: In all but one task, value-based RL performs significantly better as the amount data increases, suggesting stronger ability to leverage large batches of data for improvement. This is in contrast to IL or filtered-IL which tends to saturate with more data collected at each iteration

point: 数据规模实验M取小/中/大:Robomimic和MimicGen为50/100/200,Adroit Pen为100/200/300。
quote_en: we set M to a small, medium, and large value: 50, 100, and 200 trajectories for Robomimic and Mimicgen, and 100, 200, and 300 for Adroit Pen

point: value-based RL对batch online RL是必要但不充分的——还需正确的策略抽取方式和策略类。
quote_en: value-based RL as the algorithm class for updating the policy is necessary but not sufficient

point: 隐式策略抽取在batch online RL中显著优于显式策略抽取;显式抽取在所有任务上都没能改善策略性能。
quote_en: explicit policy extraction does not improve the policy performance on any of the tasks

point: 显式抽取在几乎每个任务上初始性能更强,但跑完batch online RL后隐式抽取显著更好。
quote_en: although explicit policy extraction achieves a stronger initial performance in nearly every benchmark task, implicit policy extraction performs significantly better after running batch online RL

point: 表达力强的扩散策略+隐式抽取在所有任务和环境上显著优于高斯策略+显式抽取。
quote_en: We find that across all tasks and environments, the former significantly outperforms the latter

point: 即便给高斯策略也配上隐式抽取,整体性能仍明显差于表达力强的策略。
quote_en: Although there is a significant improvement over Gaussian policies with explicit policy extraction, the overall performance is considerably worse than that of an expressive policy

point: 加时间相关噪声在各数据规模上都带来更高回报,但不改善数据扩展性。
quote_en: We find that the addition of temporally-correlated noise enables higher performance at each data level. However, it does not improve data scaling

point: 真实任务:7-DoF Franka Research 3抓胶带卷挂到钩子上,用RGB图像+本体状态,ResNet-18做视觉骨干,一个腕部相机+一个外部相机。
quote_en: The task involves controlling a 7-DoF Franka Research 3 robot to precisely grasp a roll of tape and hang it onto a hook

point: 真实任务设置:5条初始示范、N=3轮、每轮M=30条rollout;filtered-IL与steering基线对照,Q函数在M=90条rollout上训练。
quote_en: We collect 5 initial demonstrations in D_0 and run N = 3 iterations of batch online RL, each with M = 30 rollouts

point: 真实任务上配方3轮提升初始策略30%,filtered-IL没能改善,steering基线最差。
quote_en: Filtered-IL does not improve upon the initial performance, likely because the policy was able to capture the action distribution of the D_0 fully in pre-training. The steering baseline performs the worst

point: 作者解释隐式抽取更好的机制:新数据加入会使动作分布漂移,显式抽取的策略无法很好适应这种漂移。
quote_en: this signal becomes detrimental when new, diverse data is added during batch online RL and causes a shift in action distribution. The policy extracted from explicit policy extraction cannot adjust to this shift as well as implicit policy extraction

point: 作者解释为何在线RL中弱策略也够用而batch online RL不行:在线RL中动作分布随每步更新不断变化,而batch online RL需初始模型已捕获足够的专家动作分布。
quote_en: the initial model needs to have captured enough of an expert action distribution to collect useful trajectories that can then be used to improve the policy
